mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Skies are clear near City Hall with a temperature of 71 degrees. The overnight low will be 54 degrees, and we have no rain in the forecast tonight.

In city news, the Public Works Department continues to manage our local infrastructure, and residents are invited to subscribe to the digital newsletter to stay informed about upcoming development projects like the ones currently before the Plan Commission.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with trivia today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by a full lineup tomorrow including the Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Reviewing the weekly police report, we noted an incident on October 3 where a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following an investigation that recovered a stolen weapon.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. They are currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight.
